title: ANCHOR: An External LLM-Driven Supervisory Module Facilitating Healthy Evolution in Self-Evolving Systems
abstract: arXiv:2606.06114v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Self-evolving agents improve through continual self-play and self-generated learning signals, but their internally generated tasks and verifier signals provide limited coverage of phase-level errors, allowing capability degradation and safety drift to accumulate. We introduce ANCHOR, an LLM-based supervisory framework that delivers evaluative feedback at multiple phases of self-evolution and aggregates reviewed signals into context for subsequent steps. We retrofit two representative open-source self-evolving agent frameworks with ANCHOR, and evaluate them across coding, mathematical reasoning, and safety. Our results show that ANCHOR substantially improves safety performance while maintaining stable performance on the core capabilities of the underlying self-evolving agents. translated_abstract: 自进化智能体通过持续的自我对弈和自生成的学习信号来提升能力，但其内部生成的任务和验证器信号对阶段性错误的覆盖有限，导致能力退化和安全漂移不断累积。我们提出了ANCHOR，一种基于LLM的监督框架，它能在自进化的多个阶段提供评估性反馈，并将经审查的信号聚合为后续步骤的上下文。我们将两个具有代表性的开源自进化智能体框架改造并接入ANCHOR，并在编程、数学推理和安全性三个维度上进行评估。结果表明，ANCHOR在显著提升安全性能的同时，保持了底层自进化智能体核心能力的稳定表现。进一步的分析为未来研究提供了实用见解，显示基于执行结果的监督尤为有效，而增加……（原文截断）
tldr: ANCHOR是一个基于LLM的外部监督模块，通过在自进化系统的多个阶段提供评估反馈并聚合审查信号，在显著提升智能体安全性的同时保持其核心能力的稳定。
en_tdlr: ANCHOR is an external LLM-driven supervisory module that delivers evaluative feedback at multiple phases of self-evolution, substantially improving safety performance while maintaining stable core capabilities of self-evolving agents.
